newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-P&U seen posting $0.36 Q2 profit.
newsitem.headline: POLL-P&U seen posting $0.36 Q2 profit.

text.p: Swedish/American pharmaceutical concern Pharmacia & Upjohn is expected to post a Q2 profit of $0.36 per share compared with $0.51 in the year-ago period, according to a survey of 11 analysts.
The analysts predicted an H1 earnings per share figure before one-off items of $0.73 compared with $0.95 in the first half of 1996. First quarter 1997 earnings totalled $0.37.
Seven analysts forecast whole year earnings per share of $1.66, rising in 1998 to $1.93.
P&U will post its interim results on July 29.

No major one-off items are seen influencing the result, but P&U has downgraded its own earnings forecasts several times over the past years as it struggles to make a success of the merger of Sweden's Pharmacia and Upjohn of the U.S.
Sources: Aros, Kleinwort Benson, Ohman, CI Nordic, Penser, Matteus, Morgan Stanley, Merrill Lynch, Goldman Sachs, Lehman Brothers and BZW. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
